Who We Are

Working together for stronger communities.

Tijwun Care and Empowerment Foundation advances health and dignity, education and leadership, climate resilience, and community research with women, adolescent girls and young people at the centre of programme decisions.

Working from Jalingo with recorded activities in Adamawa, Katsina, Taraba, we combine community delivery with monitoring, safeguarding, learning and public accountability.

Our Story Annual ReportExplore Our Impact
Our Four Programme Areas

Clear programmes. One accountable mission.

Our four pillars guide practical support for women, girls and young people.

Dignity

Health, Menstrual Dignity & WASH

Improving health knowledge, menstrual wellbeing, sanitation, safety and access to essential support.

Explore programme area
Agency

Education, Skills & Leadership

Equipping women, girls and young people with knowledge, practical skills, confidence and opportunities to lead.

Explore programme area
Resilience

Climate Action & Stronger Communities

Supporting environmental action, community sanitation, volunteerism and locally led responses to social and environmental risks.

Evidence

Research, Learning & Advocacy

Using community data, monitoring, geospatial analysis and lived experience to improve programmes and influence decisions.

For Funders and Partners

Why partner with TIJCEF?

TIJCEF makes its programme evidence, governance commitments, safeguarding standards and reporting approach visible so prospective partners can conduct proportionate due diligence.

Legal & Governance

A registered Nigerian nonprofit with named programme, finance, operations and safeguarding responsibilities.

SDG & Local Alignment

Programme areas are mapped to relevant SDGs and grounded in documented community priorities.

Safeguarding & Participation

Consent, responsible storytelling and community participation are built into programme delivery.

Evidence & Reporting

Reach figures are distinguished from outcomes, reviewed against programme records and reported with context.
